variety: Argentine Spanish (Rioplatense), voseo. Read only by the Argentine voice.
pronunciation_note: English-style respelling, capitals mark the stressed syllable. Argentine accent: "ll" and "y" sound like "sh".

phrases.when: Say it when you feel sick. Add “Necesito ayuda” if it is serious.
“Duele” means hurts. Swap “la cabeza” for another body part.
“Ya” means already. Say it to calm people down. The “j” is a soft “h”.

hook: Feel sick abroad? Three phrases to say how.

dialogue.target: Me duele la cabeza. ¿Hay una farmacia?
dialogue.translation: My head hurts. Is there a pharmacy?
